title: Population Health & Care Transitions
outline: NAHQ CPHQ Detailed Content Outline (2024 R2b, in 2026 handbook)

questions.task_name: Incorporate concepts of social determinants of health into improvement activities
questions.stem: Which is an example of a social determinant of health (SDOH)?

options.A: A hereditary BRCA1 gene mutation in the family
options.B: A prescribed beta-blocker dose after discharge
options.C: A hospital's nurse-to-patient staffing ratio
options.D: Lack of transportation to appointments

questions.explanation_en: SDOH = conditions where people are born, live, learn, work, and age: economic stability, education, neighborhood, social context, and access to care.
questions.explanation_ar: نقص وسائل النقل من المحددات الاجتماعية للصحة.

questions.task_name: Incorporate techniques to address health disparities and promote equity into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: Which statement BEST describes health EQUITY rather than equality?

options.A: Giving every patient exactly the same resources and services
options.B: Treating only insured patients
options.C: Removing demographic fields from quality reports to be fair
options.D: Resources allocated by need so all can reach full health

questions.explanation_en: Equality = same for all; equity = fair, need-based. Removing demographic data hides disparities instead of addressing them.
questions.explanation_ar: الإنصاف توزيع الموارد حسب الحاجة ليصل الجميع لأفضل صحة.

questions.task_name: Analyze and use clinical, cost, equity, and social determinants of health data to drive and monitor improvement efforts
questions.stem: A hospital wants to know whether its readmission rate differs across patient groups. What is the BEST first analytic step?

options.A: Report only the overall readmission average to avoid confusion
options.B: Stratify readmissions by race, ethnicity, language, and social risk
options.C: Compare this year's rate with last year's hospital-wide total only
options.D: Exclude patients with limited English proficiency from the measure

questions.explanation_en: Stratification reveals disparities hidden inside aggregate rates and requires accurate REaL (race, ethnicity, language) data collection.
questions.explanation_ar: تقسيم المؤشر حسب العرق واللغة والعوامل الاجتماعية يكشف الفوارق.

questions.task_name: Incorporate prevention, wellness, and disease management solutions into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: A mammography screening program to detect breast cancer early is which level of prevention?

options.A: Quaternary prevention
options.B: Primary prevention
options.C: Secondary prevention
options.D: Tertiary prevention

questions.explanation_en: Primary = prevent the disease (e.g., vaccines). Secondary = early detection (screening). Tertiary = reduce complications of existing disease (e.g., cardiac rehab).
questions.explanation_ar: فحص الماموجرام للكشف المبكر وقاية ثانوية.

questions.task_name: Incorporate prevention, wellness, and disease management solutions into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: A cardiac rehabilitation program after myocardial infarction is which level of prevention?

options.A: Primary prevention
options.B: Secondary prevention
options.C: Tertiary prevention
options.D: Health promotion only

questions.explanation_en: Tertiary prevention limits disability and complications in people who already have the disease.
questions.explanation_ar: التأهيل القلبي بعد الجلطة وقاية ثالثية.

questions.task_name: Identify population health management strategies to integrate into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: A health system uses claims, diagnoses, and utilization data to identify the patients most likely to need intensive care management. What is this process called?

options.A: Utilization review
options.B: Risk stratification
options.C: Case-mix index reporting
options.D: Credentialing

questions.explanation_en: Risk stratification segments a population by predicted need so interventions can be matched to risk levels (high / rising / low).
questions.explanation_ar: تصنيف المرضى حسب المخاطر يحدد من يحتاج إدارة حالة مكثفة.

questions.task_name: Identify data and resources that are important in determining the health status of defined populations
questions.stem: U.S. nonprofit hospitals must periodically assess and prioritize the health needs of the community they serve. What is this assessment?

options.A: Root cause analysis of community events
options.B: Patient experience survey of discharged patients
options.C: Failure mode and effects analysis of services
options.D: Community Health Needs Assessment

questions.explanation_en: A CHNA (required by the ACA every 3 years, with an implementation strategy) uses community data and input to define population health priorities.
questions.explanation_ar: تقييم احتياجات صحة المجتمع CHNA مطلوب دورياً من المستشفيات غير الربحية.

questions.task_name: Identify data and resources that are important in determining the health status of defined populations
questions.stem: The number of NEW diabetes cases diagnosed in a defined population during one year is which measure?

options.A: Incidence
options.B: Case-fatality rate
options.C: Mortality rate
options.D: Prevalence

questions.explanation_en: Incidence = new cases over a period (risk). Prevalence = all existing cases at a point or period (burden).
questions.explanation_ar: الحالات الجديدة خلال فترة تُسمى معدل الحدوث (Incidence).

questions.task_name: Identify opportunities for improvement in care transitions
questions.stem: Which care-transition practice MOST directly reduces medication-related adverse events after discharge?

options.A: Shortening the discharge summary so that it is easier to read
options.B: Discharging patients earlier in the day to reduce evening errors
options.C: Providing a printed hospital map and parking guide at discharge
options.D: Medication reconciliation across admission, stay, and discharge

questions.explanation_en: Med reconciliation at each transition catches omissions, duplications, and dosing errors, a leading cause of post-discharge harm.
questions.explanation_ar: مطابقة الأدوية عند الانتقال تقلل الأحداث الدوائية بعد الخروج.

questions.task_name: Collaborate with stakeholders to improve and optimize care processes and transitions
questions.stem: A nurse asks the patient to explain in his own words how he will take his new anticoagulant. What technique is this?

options.A: Informed consent
options.B: Teach-back
options.C: SBAR
options.D: Motivational interviewing

questions.explanation_en: Teach-back confirms understanding. It tests the clarity of the TEACHING, not the patient's intelligence.
questions.explanation_ar: طريقة إعادة الشرح (Teach-back) تتأكد من فهم المريض.

questions.task_name: Collaborate with stakeholders to improve and optimize care processes and transitions
questions.stem: Taking a 'universal precautions' approach to health literacy means which of the following?

options.A: Communicate clearly with everyone, assuming anyone may struggle
options.B: Use precise medical terminology with all patients for accuracy
options.C: Give written materials only, so patients can read them at home
options.D: Screen only elderly patients for low health literacy at admission

questions.explanation_en: Literacy limitations are often invisible, so use plain language, teach-back, and simple materials for all patients.
questions.explanation_ar: افترض أن أي مريض قد يجد صعوبة في الفهم وتواصل بوضوح مع الجميع.

questions.task_name: Collaborate with stakeholders to improve and optimize care processes and transitions
questions.stem: Which tool provides a standardized structure for a nurse-to-nurse handoff when a patient moves from hospital to a skilled nursing facility?

options.A: Gantt chart of the transfer
options.B: Pareto chart of handoff errors
options.C: SBAR
options.D: Fishbone diagram of transfer delays

questions.explanation_en: Structured handoff tools (SBAR, I-PASS) reduce omissions during transitions. The other options are QI analysis or project tools.
questions.explanation_ar: أداة SBAR توحّد هيكل التسليم بين الجهات.

questions.task_name: Identify opportunities for improvement in care transitions
questions.stem: A readmission review shows many patients never attended a follow-up visit. Which intervention MOST directly targets this cause?

options.A: Give a satisfaction survey
options.B: Book follow-up before discharge and confirm access
options.C: Add a new discharge-summary template for the primary care team
options.D: Increase inpatient length of stay for all patients by one day

questions.explanation_en: Match the intervention to the root cause. A pre-booked appointment plus a check on access barriers (e.g., transportation) closes the gap.
questions.explanation_ar: حجز موعد المتابعة قبل الخروج والتأكد من إمكانية الوصول يعالج السبب.

questions.task_name: Incorporate concepts of social determinants of health into improvement activities
questions.stem: A diabetic patient is readmitted because she could not afford her insulin. What is the BEST quality response?

options.A: Re-educate her on insulin injection technique only before discharge
options.B: Screen for cost barriers and link to financial or pharmacy help
options.C: Document noncompliance in the chart and close the readmission case
options.D: Switch to a pricier insulin

questions.explanation_en: This is an SDOH (economic stability) cause, so screen and refer. Labeling a patient 'noncompliant' ignores the system and social barrier.
questions.explanation_ar: افحص عوائق التكلفة قبل الخروج واربط المريض بالمساعدة.

questions.task_name: Identify population health management strategies to integrate into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: Which care model provides team-based, comprehensive primary care that coordinates the patient's care across settings?

options.A: Patient-Centered Medical Home
options.B: Ambulatory surgery center network
options.C: Hospital-at-home acute care program only
options.D: Utilization review committee for admissions

questions.explanation_en: The PCMH emphasizes a continuous relationship, a team-based approach, coordination, access, and quality and safety.
questions.explanation_ar: البيت الطبي المتمحور حول المريض PCMH رعاية أولية شاملة بفريق.

questions.task_name: Identify population health management strategies to integrate into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: A group of providers shares accountability, and potential shared savings, for the cost and quality of care for a defined population. What is this arrangement?

options.A: Peer review organization for physicians
options.B: Group purchasing organization for supplies
options.C: Fee-for-service preferred provider network
options.D: Accountable Care Organization

questions.explanation_en: ACOs are a value-based model that links payment to population quality and total cost of care.
questions.explanation_ar: منظمة الرعاية المسؤولة ACO تتشارك المسؤولية عن التكلفة والجودة.

questions.task_name: Incorporate prevention, wellness, and disease management solutions into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: Which is an OUTCOME measure for a diabetes disease-management program?

options.A: % of patients with a foot exam
options.B: Number of certified diabetes educators hired by the program
options.C: % of enrolled patients with HbA1c at target
options.D: Percentage of enrolled patients referred to a registered dietitian

questions.explanation_en: HbA1c control is the clinical result (outcome). Exams and referrals are processes; staffing is structure. Domain 6 S-P-O logic applies here too.
questions.explanation_ar: نسبة المرضى الذين وصل HbA1c لديهم للهدف مقياس نتيجة.

questions.task_name: Incorporate concepts of social determinants of health into improvement activities
questions.stem: SDOH screening finds high food insecurity among clinic patients. Which action BEST integrates SDOH into improvement work?

options.A: Closed-loop referrals to food banks with tracked outcomes
options.B: Document the food insecurity in the chart but take no further action
options.C: Exclude them from quality measures
options.D: Refer patients to a food bank list without any follow-up or tracking

questions.explanation_en: Effective SDOH work = screen, refer, close the loop, and measure, often through community partnerships.
questions.explanation_ar: الشراكة مع المنظمات المجتمعية بإحالة مغلقة الحلقة وقياس النتائج.

questions.task_name: Analyze and use clinical, cost, equity, and social determinants of health data to drive and monitor improvement efforts
questions.stem: Which ICD-10-CM code category is used to document social determinants of health?

options.A: DRG weights
options.B: CPT Category II codes
options.C: Z codes (Z55-Z65)
options.D: E codes for endocrine disorders

questions.explanation_en: Z55-Z65 capture factors such as housing, food, education, and employment problems. These data make SDOH measurable.
questions.explanation_ar: رموز Z55-Z65 توثق المحددات الاجتماعية للصحة.

questions.task_name: Identify opportunities for improvement in care transitions
questions.stem: A program assigns a trained coach who meets the patient before discharge and follows up at home to build self-management skills (medications, red flags, follow-up). What is this intervention?

options.A: Transition coaching
options.B: Concurrent coding review
options.C: Utilization review at discharge
options.D: Prior authorization for home services

questions.explanation_en: Transition coaching models empower patients and caregivers to manage the handoff home and have been associated with lower readmissions.
questions.explanation_ar: التدريب على الانتقال يبني مهارات الإدارة الذاتية بعد الخروج.

questions.task_name: Identify data and resources that are important in determining the health status of defined populations
questions.stem: A town of 50,000 has 2,500 people living with diabetes on 1 January. What is the diabetes prevalence?
questions.explanation_en: Prevalence = existing cases / population = 2,500 / 50,000 = 5%.
questions.explanation_ar: معدل الانتشار = 2500 ÷ 50000 = 5%.

questions.task_name: Identify data and resources that are important in determining the health status of defined populations
questions.stem: County A has a higher crude mortality rate than County B, but County A has a much older population. What is needed for a fair comparison?

options.A: Comparing the total number of deaths
options.B: Excluding elderly residents from both counties
options.C: Crude mortality rates for each county only
options.D: Age-adjusted mortality rates

questions.explanation_en: Age adjustment removes differences due to age structure.
questions.explanation_ar: يجب استخدام معدلات معدّلة حسب العمر للمقارنة العادلة.

questions.task_name: Identify data and resources that are important in determining the health status of defined populations
questions.stem: A health system wants to understand the health status of its attributed population. Which combination of data is MOST useful?

options.A: Only the inpatient census and bed occupancy data
options.B: Claims, EHR, registry, and community health data
options.C: Only the system's audited annual financial statements
options.D: Only staff surveys about community health concerns

questions.explanation_en: Population health assessment combines clinical, utilization, and community data.
questions.explanation_ar: دمج بيانات المطالبات والسجلات والسجلات الوطنية والصحة العامة.

questions.task_name: Identify data and resources that are important in determining the health status of defined populations
questions.stem: Which measure describes the proportion of people who die from a disease among those who have it?

options.A: Prevalence of the disease
options.B: Crude death rate of the population
options.C: Incidence of new disease cases
options.D: Case-fatality rate

questions.explanation_en: Case-fatality rate = deaths from the disease / people with the disease.
questions.explanation_ar: معدل الوفيات بين المصابين يسمى معدل الإماتة.

questions.task_name: Identify data and resources that are important in determining the health status of defined populations
questions.stem: A hospital's CHNA identifies obesity, mental health access, and maternal outcomes as top community needs. What should happen NEXT?

options.A: Address only the needs that are likely to generate new revenue
options.B: An implementation strategy with partners, actions, and measures
options.C: Publish the report on the website without any follow-up action
options.D: File the report and wait three years for the next assessment

questions.explanation_en: A CHNA must be followed by an implementation strategy addressing prioritized needs.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد التقييم تُعدّ استراتيجية تنفيذ بالشركاء والإجراءات والمقاييس.

questions.task_name: Identify population health management strategies to integrate into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: A health plan finds that 5% of members account for 50% of costs. What is the BEST population health strategy?

options.A: Apply the same intervention to all members regardless of their risk
options.B: Disenroll the highest-cost members at the next renewal period
options.C: Focus only on healthy members to keep them from becoming high-cost
options.D: Risk-stratify and manage the highest-risk members intensively

questions.explanation_en: Matching intervention intensity to risk level is the core of population health management.
questions.explanation_ar: صنّف المخاطر وقدّم إدارة رعاية مكثفة للأعلى خطورة.

questions.task_name: Identify population health management strategies to integrate into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: The IHI Triple Aim focuses on which three goals?

options.A: Staffing, supplies, and space
options.B: Accreditation, licensure, and specialty certification
options.C: Experience, population health, and per-capita cost
options.D: Increasing revenue, patient volume, and market share

questions.explanation_en: The Quadruple Aim adds care-team well-being.
questions.explanation_ar: الهدف الثلاثي: تجربة المريض، صحة السكان، خفض التكلفة للفرد.

questions.task_name: Identify population health management strategies to integrate into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: An ACO's high-risk patients are rising-risk diabetics who are not yet high utilizers. Which strategy offers the BEST long-term value?

options.A: Wait until these patients are hospitalized, then manage them
options.B: Increase specialist referrals for every patient with diabetes
options.C: Proactive outreach and self-management support
options.D: Focus only on high utilizers

questions.explanation_en: Managing rising-risk patients prevents them from becoming high-cost.
questions.explanation_ar: التدخل المبكر لفئة المخاطر المتصاعدة يمنع تحولها لعالية التكلفة.

questions.task_name: Identify population health management strategies to integrate into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: Which payment model gives providers the STRONGEST incentive to keep a population healthy?

options.A: Traditional fee-for-service payment for each visit
options.B: Capitation or shared savings with quality targets
options.C: Paying a fixed amount for each inpatient day
options.D: Paying separately for each lab test and procedure

questions.explanation_en: Population-based payment rewards prevention and efficient care rather than volume.
questions.explanation_ar: الدفع بالفرد أو الوفورات المشتركة يحفز الحفاظ على صحة السكان.

questions.task_name: Incorporate prevention, wellness, and disease management solutions into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: An influenza vaccination campaign for employees is an example of which level of prevention?

options.A: Primary prevention
options.B: Quaternary prevention
options.C: Tertiary prevention
options.D: Secondary prevention

questions.explanation_en: Primary prevention stops disease before it occurs.
questions.explanation_ar: التطعيم وقاية أولية تمنع المرض قبل حدوثه.

questions.task_name: Incorporate prevention, wellness, and disease management solutions into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: A diabetes program improved foot-exam rates from 60% to 90%, but amputation rates are unchanged after two years. What is the BEST next step?

options.A: Declare success, since the foot-exam process measure has improved
options.B: Reduce the exam frequency
options.C: Stop foot exams because they have not lowered amputation rates
options.D: Check whether abnormal exams get timely follow-up care

questions.explanation_en: Process gains must link to downstream actions to change outcomes.
questions.explanation_ar: تحقق من متابعة وعلاج المرضى ذوي الفحص غير الطبيعي.

questions.task_name: Incorporate prevention, wellness, and disease management solutions into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: Which element is MOST characteristic of an effective chronic disease management program?

options.A: Specialist-only care for all patients with the disease
options.B: A care-gap registry plus self-management support
options.C: Hospital-based care only
options.D: Annual visits only, with no contact between appointments

questions.explanation_en: The Chronic Care Model emphasizes registries, decision support, and self-management.
questions.explanation_ar: سجل للمرضى لكشف الفجوات مع دعم الإدارة الذاتية.

questions.task_name: Incorporate techniques to address health disparities and promote equity into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: A patient with limited English proficiency needs discharge teaching. What is BEST practice?

options.A: A qualified medical interpreter, translated materials, teach-back
options.B: Give the standard English instructions only and a phone number
options.C: Speak more slowly and loudly in English during the teaching
options.D: Ask the patient's 12-year-old child to interpret the instructions

questions.explanation_en: Professional interpreters reduce errors; family members, especially children, are inappropriate for clinical communication.
questions.explanation_ar: استخدم مترجماً طبياً مؤهلاً ولا تعتمد على أفراد الأسرة.

questions.task_name: Incorporate techniques to address health disparities and promote equity into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: Stratified data show hypertension control at 75% for English speakers and 52% for Arabic-speaking patients in a US clinic. What is the BEST next step?

options.A: Assume the Arabic-speaking patients are noncompliant with treatment
options.B: Explore causes with affected patients and target the gap
options.C: Report only the overall clinic average to leadership and payers
options.D: Remove language data from reports

questions.explanation_en: Equity work identifies gaps, engages affected groups, and targets interventions.
questions.explanation_ar: حلل أسباب الفجوة مع المرضى المتأثرين وصمم تدخلات موجهة.

questions.task_name: Incorporate techniques to address health disparities and promote equity into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: The National CLAS Standards address which area?

options.A: Coding accuracy and documentation standards
options.B: Culturally and linguistically appropriate services
options.C: Clinical laboratory accuracy and proficiency
options.D: Capital budgeting for community health programs

questions.explanation_en: CLAS standards guide equitable, culturally competent, and language-accessible care.
questions.explanation_ar: معايير CLAS تخص الخدمات الملائمة ثقافياً ولغوياً.

questions.task_name: Incorporate techniques to address health disparities and promote equity into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: How should an organization measure progress on a health equity goal?

options.A: Track the number of equity committee meetings held each year
options.B: Track staff diversity only
options.C: Track only overall averages for the whole patient population
options.D: Track the gap between groups over time

questions.explanation_en: Equity progress means narrowing disparities between groups.
questions.explanation_ar: قِس الفجوة بين الفئات عبر الزمن لا المعدل العام فقط.

questions.task_name: Incorporate techniques to address health disparities and promote equity into improvement initiatives
questions.stem: Which data collection practice BEST supports identifying disparities?

options.A: Avoid collecting demographic data so that no patient feels singled out
options.B: Self-reported REaL data in standard categories
options.C: Collect data from insured patients only
options.D: Have registration staff record their best guess of each patient's ethnicity

questions.explanation_en: Accurate self-reported demographic data enable stratification.
questions.explanation_ar: جمع بيانات العرق والإثنية واللغة بالإبلاغ الذاتي يمكّن من كشف الفوارق.

questions.task_name: Analyze and use clinical, cost, equity, and social determinants of health data to drive and monitor improvement efforts
questions.stem: A readmission dashboard shows similar overall rates for two clinics, but Clinic A serves many patients with housing insecurity. Stratified rates for those patients are twice as high. What should leaders do?

options.A: Conclude the clinics perform equally
options.B: Penalize Clinic A for its higher rate among housing-insecure patients
options.C: Target housing-insecure patients and track the stratified rate
options.D: Remove housing data from the analysis so that clinics compare fairly

questions.explanation_en: Stratification reveals hidden disparities that aggregate rates mask.
questions.explanation_ar: وجّه التدخلات لمن يعانون من عدم استقرار السكن وراقب المؤشر المقسّم.

questions.task_name: Analyze and use clinical, cost, equity, and social determinants of health data to drive and monitor improvement efforts
questions.stem: Which combination of data BEST builds a business case for a community health worker program?

options.A: Only national averages for community health worker programs
options.B: Only the number of brochures distributed in the community last year
options.C: Utilization, cost, outcome, and SDOH data for the target group
options.D: Only staff opinions about whether community health workers help

questions.explanation_en: Combining clinical, cost, and SDOH data shows both need and value.
questions.explanation_ar: دمج بيانات الاستخدام والتكلفة والنتائج والمحددات الاجتماعية يبني مبرر المشروع.

questions.task_name: Analyze and use clinical, cost, equity, and social determinants of health data to drive and monitor improvement efforts
questions.stem: A team wants to monitor an equity-focused diabetes intervention. Which measure is MOST appropriate?

options.A: HbA1c control stratified by income and language
options.B: Average HbA1c for all clinic patients combined only
options.C: Total number of clinic visits
options.D: Number of diabetes educators hired for the program

questions.explanation_en: Stratified outcome measures show whether disparities are narrowing.
questions.explanation_ar: مقياس النتيجة المقسّم حسب الدخل واللغة يبين تضييق الفجوات.

questions.task_name: Analyze and use clinical, cost, equity, and social determinants of health data to drive and monitor improvement efforts
questions.stem: Which data source BEST captures social needs at the patient level for analysis?

options.A: Standardized SDOH screening in the EHR (Z codes)
options.B: The hospital's published annual community report
options.C: Census data only for the surrounding neighborhoods
options.D: Staff engagement survey results by department

questions.explanation_en: Patient-level screening data documented consistently enable analysis of social risk.
questions.explanation_ar: فحص المحددات الاجتماعية الموحد في السجل الإلكتروني مع رموز Z.

questions.task_name: Identify opportunities for improvement in care transitions
questions.stem: Readmission review shows most heart failure readmissions occur within 7 days and involve weight gain not reported by patients. Which intervention BEST targets this?

options.A: Longer discharge summaries
options.B: More inpatient lab tests before discharge to confirm the patient is stable
options.C: 48–72-hour calls plus daily-weight teaching with action thresholds
options.D: A patient satisfaction survey mailed to every heart failure patient after discharge

questions.explanation_en: Interventions should match the root cause: early follow-up and self-monitoring education.
questions.explanation_ar: اتصال بعد الخروج خلال 48-72 ساعة وتعليم مراقبة الوزن اليومي.

questions.task_name: Identify opportunities for improvement in care transitions
questions.stem: When should discharge planning begin for a hospitalized patient?

options.A: At admission
options.B: Only if the patient requests it
options.C: After the physician writes the discharge order
options.D: On the day of discharge

questions.explanation_en: Early discharge planning identifies needs and barriers in time to address them.
questions.explanation_ar: يبدأ التخطيط للخروج منذ الدخول.

questions.task_name: Identify opportunities for improvement in care transitions
questions.stem: Patients discharged to skilled nursing facilities often arrive without medication lists, causing errors. Where is the BEST improvement opportunity?

options.A: The ED triage process
options.B: The hospital admissions office and bed management process
options.C: The skilled nursing facility's billing and insurance process
options.D: The hospital-to-SNF handoff: what is sent and when

questions.explanation_en: Information loss at transitions is a key opportunity; focus on the handoff itself.
questions.explanation_ar: فرصة التحسين في عملية التسليم بين المستشفى ودار الرعاية.

questions.task_name: Identify opportunities for improvement in care transitions
questions.stem: Which measure is MOST commonly used to evaluate the quality of care transitions?

options.A: Staff overtime
options.B: Number of beds
options.C: 30-day readmission rate
options.D: Operating room turnover time

questions.explanation_en: Readmissions are widely used to reflect transition quality.
questions.explanation_ar: معدل إعادة الدخول خلال 30 يوماً يعكس جودة الانتقالات.

questions.task_name: Collaborate with stakeholders to improve and optimize care processes and transitions
questions.stem: A hospital's COPD readmissions are high, and many patients go to two local home-health agencies. What is the BEST collaborative strategy?

options.A: Ask the agencies to submit complaints when patients are readmitted
options.B: Stop referring patients to those two agencies and choose new ones
options.C: A joint team with the agencies to standardize handoffs and share data
options.D: Fix only the hospital's internal discharge processes for COPD patients

questions.explanation_en: Transition problems span settings; collaboration across providers improves results.
questions.explanation_ar: شكّل فريقاً مشتركاً مع وكالات الرعاية المنزلية لتوحيد التسليم.

questions.task_name: Collaborate with stakeholders to improve and optimize care processes and transitions
questions.stem: What is a 'warm handoff' in care transitions?

options.A: Leaving a voicemail for the receiving clinician after the patient leaves
options.B: A live clinician-to-clinician exchange, ideally with the patient
options.C: Faxing records after discharge
options.D: Giving the patient a sealed envelope of records to hand to the next provider

questions.explanation_en: Warm handoffs reduce information loss and build patient trust.
questions.explanation_ar: التسليم الدافئ تواصل مباشر بين مقدمي الرعاية بحضور المريض.

questions.task_name: Incorporate concepts of social determinants of health into improvement activities
questions.stem: An SDOH screen identifies a patient with unstable housing. What completes a closed-loop referral?

options.A: Confirming the patient got the service and documenting it
options.B: Telling the patient to search online for local housing programs
options.C: Giving the patient a phone number
options.D: Documenting the housing Z code in the record and closing the case

questions.explanation_en: Closed-loop referrals track whether the patient actually received the service.
questions.explanation_ar: الإحالة مغلقة الحلقة تتأكد من حصول المريض على الخدمة وتوثّق النتيجة.

questions.task_name: Incorporate concepts of social determinants of health into improvement activities
questions.stem: A clinic labels patients who miss appointments as 'noncompliant.' SDOH screening shows many lack transportation. What is the BEST improvement?

options.A: Add more reminder calls only
options.B: Discharge patients from the clinic after two missed visits
options.C: Offer transport help or telehealth and track no-shows
options.D: Document noncompliance more strongly in every patient's chart

questions.explanation_en: Addressing the social barrier is more effective than labeling the patient.
questions.explanation_ar: عالج عائق النقل بالمساعدة أو الرعاية عن بعد بدل وصم المريض.

questions.task_name: Incorporate concepts of social determinants of health into improvement activities
questions.stem: Which of the following is a health-related social need (HRSN)?

options.A: Hypertension
options.B: Medication allergy
options.C: Genetic predisposition
options.D: Food insecurity

questions.explanation_en: HRSNs include food, housing, transportation, utilities, and interpersonal safety.
questions.explanation_ar: انعدام الأمن الغذائي من الاحتياجات الاجتماعية المرتبطة بالصحة.
